Method of Attack: Encrypts files using AES-256 in CBC mode with a random key, appends .chsch extension to encrypted files, drops ransom notes impersonating a movie character
Deployed via PowerShell script named POWERGAP
Ransomware payload distribution from domain controller using PowerShell script
Attack Vector: PowerShell script used to distribute ransomware from domain controller
Indicators of Compromise: ransom notes impersonating James P. Sullivan
